je_pmr_dam_columbia_river_survey = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_map.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 30
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"

		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|mantaro_canon_del_pato|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|mantaro_canon_del_pato|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 12
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x3060D7 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_mantaro_canon_del_pato_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|mantaro_canon_del_pato|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"

	group = je_group_technology

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months }
				change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months add = 1 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_month|nepal_hill_rivers|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
			}
		}
	}

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry = { is_goal_complete = yes }
	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|nepal_hill_rivers|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 12
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months }
			NOT = {
				p:xDA8130 ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveying
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_nepal_hill_rivers_surveying
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_ended|nepal_hill_rivers|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	progressbar = yes
	weight = 10
	transferable = no
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	}

	on_complete = {
		remove_modifier = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveying
		remove_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveying
		set_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveyed
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveyed_any
		set_global_variable = { name = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_claim days = 730 }
		change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = -1 }
		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_complete|lawpita_falls|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
	}

	current_value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months }
			value = root.var:pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months
		}
	}

	goal_add_value = {
		value = 12
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months }
			NOT = {
				p:x02F3AF ?= {
					state ?= {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = ROOT
								any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalid = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months }
			remove_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_months
		}
		remove_global_variable = pmr_dam_lawpita_falls_surveying

	}

		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pmr_dam_lower_yalu_months }

		}
	}

		value = 24
	}
